modified_caption: The pie chart illustrates the impact of optimized deployment strategies on time efficiency, revealing a substantial but uneven reduction in temporal expenditure. The total time cost prior to optimization is approximately 87.1s (26.2s for efficient deployment and 60.9s for reduction), which is subsequently diminished by roughly 58.3% following the implementation of streamlined protocols. Notably, the reduction phase, though dominant at 60.9s (69.92%), has stabilized rather than declined sharply, suggesting diminishing returns in further optimization efforts. Conversely, the efficient deployment segment, accounting for 26.2s (30.08%), has consistently surpassed initial projections, indicating untapped potential for additional time savings in this category.
